page_title: EVE 1-2 LUT | Everton v Luton 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but Thomas Kaminski punches the ball away.
90+5' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Luton.
90+3' Jack Harrison (Everton) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
90+3' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
90+1' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
87' Beto (Everton) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
86' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
85' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
84' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Dwight McNeil will be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cauley Woodrow (Luton) comes onto the pitch so that Alfie Doughty can be given a rest.
83' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Nathan Patterson (Everton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
81' Thomas Kaminski (Luton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Ashley Young and he is replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
78' Substitution. Carlton Morris leaves the pitch and is replaced by Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
78' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Beto (Everton) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
78' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
76' Beto (Everton) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
73' Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
72' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by James Garner (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
71' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' Issa Kabore (Luton) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
65' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Carlton Morris (Luton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' A goal, which was scored by Carlton Morris (Luton), was disallowed due to offside.
62' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post.
62' Jack Harrison (Everton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
61' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Jack Harrison (Everton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Beto (Everton) is coming onto the pitch as Abdoulaye Doucoure cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' Alfie Doughty (Luton) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
58' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Amadou Onana (Everton) and blew his whistle. Luton are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
56' Rob Edwards is forced to make a change. Tom Lockyer is unable to continue due to injury, Teden Mengi (Luton) comes on.
56' Tom Lockyer (Luton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Ashley Young (Everton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
54' The game is interrupted now, Ashley Young (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Jack Harrison (Everton) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
52' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
51' Luton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
47' The ball is out of play. Luton will take a throw-in. Alfie Doughty (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) replacing Reece Burke.
46' The referee signals a substitution. Jack Harrison (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Idrissa Gueye.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Thomas Kaminski comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+6' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+3' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45+2' James Garner (Everton) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
45+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' 1 - 2 Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
41' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
40' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has a goal ruled out for offside!

40' What a poor attempt! Amadou Onana (Everton) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
40' A pass by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' The ball is cleared after Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is behind the touchline and Everton will take a throw-in.
40' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 67:33.
39' Some patient build-up play from Everton as they look to unlock the defence.
38' James Garner (Everton) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
37' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Everton are taking a throw-in.
36' A cross into the box from Amadou Onana (Everton) is cleared.
36' Ashley Young (Everton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
31' 0 - 2 Carlton Morris (Luton) wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and fires a superb strike into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
30' Flag up against Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
29' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
29' Everton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Tom Lockyer (Luton) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
24' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is about to take a corner kick.
24' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Luton earn a corner.
20' The corner is swung in but Luton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' The linesman raises his flag. Carlton Morris (Luton) is adjudged offside.
17' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' Amadou Onana (Everton) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
15' A pass by James Garner (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' James Garner (Everton) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
10' Issa Kabore (Luton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Alfie Doughty (Luton) launches a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford is alert to thwart the effort.
8' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
7' The Luton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
5' A rebound falls at the feet of Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches wide of the right post! What a great effort!
4' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It's a throw-in for Everton.
3' Luton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

Luton will kick the game off.
